text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The graded mile race, the New Zealand 
Trophy. The journey of chasing after the 
Emperor of the Mile truly begins right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr steps into the paddock. 
Cheers from the audience rain down upon 
her. At that moment, she feels a strange 
sensation in her ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A buzzing, prickling sensation. Yet it 
wasn't unpleasant in the slightest. Filled 
with wonder, she headed into the race.
